_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_horde_15-20 is written in a later phase.

W_XP_RANGE: pack gap, not a pacing choice. Counted XP (main and optional, non-class, not done in 05-10) is about 12.2k of the 50.8k budget (24%). Class chains add about 5.2k and elite steps (99, 452, 95328, 99156) about 2.7k, both excluded by the validator. The 05-10 band already consumed most Brill and Undercity quests. The 443 Rot Hide chain (about 2.4k) waits for horde_horde_15-20 (mobs 17-19). The rest of the budget has to come from kills, which are not modelled. Needs a pipeline or band-pack decision.
